issues.legal_issue: The family’s documents effected a transfer of the mortgage interest to a charitable trust.
material_facts: A family agreement created a trust for charitable purposes and set aside a specified amount for it.
A later document set apart the family’s usufructuary mortgage interest for the charity in discharge of the family’s obligation under the agreement.
A registered partition deed affirmed the dedication of the mortgage interest to the charity.
issues.conclusion: The documents established that the family transferred its mortgage interest to the charitable trust in discharge of its earlier obligation.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 9-A(10)(ii)(b) of the Madras Agriculturists Relief Act, the mortgagee’s rights must have been transferred for valuable consideration to attract the exemption from scaling down. The court interpreted the documents together and found that they established a transfer of the mortgage interest to the charity.

rule.if: mortgage_scaling_proceeding and family_created_charitable_trust and family_set_apart_mortgage_interest_for_charity_in_discharge_of_trust_obligation and later_partition_deed_confirmed_dedication

predicates.mortgage_scaling_proceeding: A proceeding was brought to scale down a mortgage debt.
predicates.family_created_charitable_trust: Members of a family created a trust for charitable purposes.
predicates.family_set_apart_mortgage_interest_for_c: The family dedicated its mortgage interest to the charity to discharge an obligation it had undertaken to the trust.
predicates.later_partition_deed_confirmed_dedicatio: A later partition deed affirmed the dedication of the mortgage interest to the charity.

issues.definition: When a mortgage-scaling proceeding concerns a family that created a charitable trust, dedicated its mortgage interest to discharge an obligation to that trust, and later affirmed the dedication in a partition deed, the mortgage interest was transferred to the charitable trust.

issues.legal_issue: A transfer of mortgage rights to discharge an existing obligation to a charity is for valuable consideration when the charity gives up its right to enforce that obligation.
material_facts: The family had undertaken to provide a specified sum to the charitable trust.
The family transferred its mortgage interest to the trust in discharge of that obligation.
In exchange, the charity gave up its right to recover the amount owed by the family.
The transfer occurred within the period specified for the statutory exemption.
issues.conclusion: The transfer was for valuable consideration within the meaning of section 9-A(10)(ii)(b), so the mortgage debt was not liable to be scaled down.
issues.legal_principle: Section 9-A(10)(ii)(b) of the Madras Agriculturists Relief Act exempts qualifying mortgage rights transferred bona fide and for valuable consideration during the specified period. Section 2(d) of the Contract Act encompasses an act or abstinence as consideration, and the court relied on the definition in Currie v. Misa that valuable consideration may consist of a right or benefit accruing to one party, or forbearance, detriment, loss, or responsibility undertaken by the other. The charity’s forbearance from enforcing its right to recover the amount owed was valuable consideration for the mortgage interest.

predicates.mortgage_scaling_proceeding: A proceeding was brought to scale down a mortgage debt.
predicates.mortgage_interest_transferred_bona_fide_: The mortgage interest was transferred bona fide during the period in which such transfers qualify for the exemption.
predicates.family_owed_charity_under_prior_commitme: The family owed the charity an amount under an earlier commitment.
predicates.charity_relinquished_recovery_right_in_e: The charity gave up its right to recover the amount owed in exchange for the mortgage interest.

issues.definition: When, in a mortgage-scaling proceeding, mortgage rights are transferred bona fide within the qualifying period to discharge an existing debt to a charity and the charity gives up its recovery right in exchange, the mortgage debt is not eligible for scaling down.

issues.legal_issue: A new challenge to the validity of a transfer cannot be raised for the first time on appeal when it was not raised earlier in the litigation.
material_facts: The appellants argued for the first time before the Supreme Court that the transfer was invalid because it had not been effected by a registered document.
The appellants had not raised that ground at any earlier stage of the litigation.
A registered partition deed was part of the record.
issues.conclusion: The Court did not permit the appellants to raise the registration challenge for the first time before it.
issues.legal_principle: The Court declined to entertain a plea that had not been raised at any stage of the litigation before being advanced in the Supreme Court. It cited no provision or earlier case for this ruling.

predicates.appeal_proceeding: A party brought an appeal before a higher court.
predicates.challenge_first_raised_on_appeal: A party advanced a challenge for the first time in the appeal.
predicates.challenge_not_raised_at_earlier_stages: The party had not raised that challenge at any earlier stage of the litigation.

issues.definition: In an appeal, a challenge first advanced on appeal and not raised at earlier stages is not permitted.
